verdict.purpose: The headline banner sentence that states beat / in-line / miss.

figure.purpose: Stat card numbers; always tabular numerals.

motion.name: orb-breathe
motion.purpose: AI orb idle life; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Rail becomes bottom bar, KPI grid 2x2, copilot icon-only.

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Base container for every section; glass surface, rest shadow, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,.80); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.3); border: 1px solid rgba(18,20,26,.08); border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(18,20,26,.04), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(18,20,26,.14); padding: 18px 20px; color: #12141A; font-family: Pretendard, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(18,20,26,.05), 0 18px 36px -16px rgba(40,52,140,.26); } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 650; font-size: .95rem; letter-spacing: -.02em; margin-bottom: 8px; }

components.name: Stat Card (beat)
components.description: KPI figure tinted by its verdict, with a verdict chip.
components.css: .ds-stat { background: #E7F5EF; border-radius: 20px; padding: 18px 20px; font-family: Pretendard, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #12141A; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: .86rem; font-weight: 600; color: #474C59; } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: -.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin: 6px 0 10px; } .ds-chip-beat { background: #E2F3EB; color: #0E8058; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 9px; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Verdict Chips
components.description: Beat / in-line / miss; the only uses of the verdict colours.
components.html: 서프라이즈 부합 쇼크
components.css: .ds-chip { border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 9px; font: 650 .78rem Pretendard, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-beat { background: #E2F3EB; color: #0E8058; } .ds-inline { background: #F7EEDA; color: #8C5F0E; } .ds-miss { background: #FBE8E4; color: #C23E2C; }

components.name: Consensus Strip
components.description: Signature: low–high consensus band, average tick and actual dot, built from positioned spans.
components.css: .ds-strip { position: relative; height: 16px; width: 240px; } .ds-line { position: absolute; top: 7px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: rgba(18,20,26,.14); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-band { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 30%; width: 35%; height: 8px; background: #E7EAFE; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-tick { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 47%; width: 2px; height: 12px; background: #3346C9; } .ds-dot { position: absolute; top: 1px; left: 72%; width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-left: -7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #0E8058; border: 2.5px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(18,20,26,.25); }

components.name: AI Orb
components.description: Signature: blob with eyes whose hue is the call tone; grey with half-closed eyes when idle.
components.css: .ds-orb { position: relative; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, #C7CFFB, #4C63F0 55%, #3346C9 100%); box-shadow: inset -6px -8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 10px 26px -10px rgba(76,99,240,.55); } .ds-orb::before, .ds-orb::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 40%; width: 11%; height: 19%; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; } .ds-orb::before { left: 34%; } .ds-orb::after { right: 34%; }

components.name: Ask Lens Button
components.css: .ds-copilot { background: rgba(18,20,26,.9); color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 18px 10px 14px; min-height: 48px; backdrop-filter: blur(14px); font: 650 .9rem Pretendard, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px -14px rgba(40,52,140,.6); transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-copilot:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -16px rgba(40,52,140,.7); } .ds-copilot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4C63F0; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: An earnings desk where every headline number states its verdict against the street. Soft neutral glass cards on a cool ground; colour is reserved for verdicts and the AI orb's call tone.
keyCharacteristics: Each figure carries its consensus strip
Verdict colours used only for beat / in-line / miss
Glass cards with staggered rise and hover lift

rules.name: Verdict Colour Rule
rules.body: Beat, in-line and miss colours appear only for verdicts and up/down/live state.

rules.name: Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: Elevation is the rest and lift pair only; no hard offset shadows.

dos: Do define new tokens only in theme.css :root and mirror chart colours in components.py.
Do give every figure a verdict and a source badge.
Do draw graphics with positioned spans.
donts: Don't use <svg> in st.html; it is stripped.
Don't tint a stat card when there is no consensus.
